summary: Zenas BioPharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement replacing its October 8, 2025 at-the-market program, terminating the prior $200 million facility after selling roughly $153.2 million of common stock and establishing a fresh $200 million ATM through sales agent Jefferies. Shares sold at prevailing market prices; last reported sale on November 4, 2026 was $28.46, with Jefferies compensated up to 3.0% of gross proceeds and no escrow arrangement. This is an ordinary shelf takedown/sales-agreement update, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor opinion, premium or regulatory clock applies. Watch dilution pace and any acceleration in selling pressure.
